notes: SBLGNT.MAT.4.23.v011 selects r01, which expresses Ἰησοῦς; the ASV's variant note (*Some ancient authorities read he*) corroborates the selected reading rather than the alternative, so no token is added or surplus.
*all manner of* is kept whole on πᾶσαν and headed on *all*, following rule 99's quantifier clause.
περιῆγεν keeps *about* for its preverb inside the verb's unit, headed on the verbal word (rule 106).
Both τῇ before Γαλιλαίᾳ and ταῖς before συναγωγαῖς are emptied — the first for want of a determiner (rule 23), the second by αὐτῶν (rule 20).
